what.name: Rule or setup, line 1 from the source
what.value_plain: ATR(14) Wilder on the bar's own TF, strictly causal, defined from bar index 14 (TR[0] undefined). Plain-SMA ATR is stored beside it (labels_.csv atr_sma) because MTS core uses SMA (FORMULAS.md section 12; F-BT-07).

what.name: Rule or setup, line 4 from the source
what.value_plain: Times are bar CLOSE times. dur_bars = end pivot bar - start pivot bar. Forward labels: entry = next bar open, window H in [24, 96] bars, unit = ATR at the decision bar.
